The builder is likely to recover $13,000, calculated as the contract price ($20,000) minus the cost avoided by not completing the work ($5,000) minus the resale value of the unused materials ($1,000), which equals $14,000, but capped by the actual benefit conferred to the homeowner ($3,000) plus the builder’s reliance damages ($10,000 spent less $1,000 recouped = $9,000), yielding $12,000; however, under the standard contract measure, the builder recovers $14,000, so the likely recovery is $14,000.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
